game.title: Watch Dogs: Legion
game.blurb: Open-world hacking action-adventure set in London, from Ubisoft Toronto, released 2020-10-29. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours (far under a full run). Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: From Operation Westminster through the 404, Kelley, SIRS, Albion and DedSec storylines. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Recruiting and Liberating London
chapters.summary: Recruiting operatives, revenge missions, DedSec adversaries and turning boroughs Defiant.

chapters.title: Combat, Gadgets and Stunts
chapters.summary: Takedowns, gadgets, hacks, disguises and escapes.

chapters.title: Activities and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Kick-Ups, darts, Paste Ups, drinks, Parcel Fox deliveries, audio logs and relics.

chapters.title: Upgrades and Style
chapters.summary: Weapon skins, vehicle paint, clothes, upgrades and weapon upgrades.

chapters.title: Bloodline (expansion)
chapters.summary: The Bloodline expansion: its missions, upgrades and data drives.

chapters.title: Resistance Missions and Resistance Mode
chapters.summary: Resistance missions for four operatives and the full campaign on Resistance mode.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough and Table of Contents are linked but no subpages exist. watchdogs.fandom.com answers the API, with about 62 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 49 Steam achievements are hidden. "Breaking The Ice", "Switcheroo" and "One Big Happy Family" were put in Bloodline by their schema position next to the two named Bloodline achievements; that is an inference and needs checking. Story descriptions name missions and factions, so the story chapter stays spoiler-guarded.
